lines.t: On September 17, the SEC opened a new door for tokenized stocks.
lines.say: On September seventeenth, the S.E.C. opened a new door for tokenized stocks.

lines.t: Here's what it allows, and who wins.
The Innovation Exemption lets a new kind of venue trade tokenized US stocks through AMM liquidity pools,
lines.say: The Innovation Exemption lets a new kind of venue trade tokenized U.S. stocks through A.M.M. liquidity pools,

lines.t: without registering as an exchange.
It lasts five years, until 2031.
The rules are strict.
Tokens must carry the same rights as the real share, like dividends and votes. Synthetic tokens are out.
Companies can block third-party tokens of their own stock.
Volumes are capped, trading halts when the exchange halts, and there's no margin.
And ordinary US investors can take part, through verified wallets.
lines.say: And ordinary U.S. investors can take part, through verified wallets.

lines.t: Which blockchains?
The venue's code must run on a public chain that anyone can read and write to, without permission.
Ethereum and Solana clearly fit.
Layer twos aren't mentioned, so each venue will have to make its case.
Permissioned chains are the grey zone.
Tempo lets anyone deploy contracts, but its validators are hand-picked, so it may need a nod from SEC staff.
lines.say: Tempo lets anyone deploy contracts, but its validators are hand-picked, so it may need a nod from S.E.C. staff.

lines.t: Fully private bank ledgers don't qualify.
In DeFi, the big winner is the AMM.
lines.say: In dee-fi, the big winner is the A.M.M.

lines.t: Uniswap v4's permissioned pools already check an allowlist before every trade, the model the SEC describes.
lines.say: Uniswap v four's permissioned pools already check an allow-list before every trade, the model the S.E.C. describes.

lines.t: UNI jumped about 30%. But a regulated US company still has to run the venue.
lines.say: Uni jumped about thirty percent. But a regulated U.S. company still has to run the venue.

lines.t: Lending is a different story.
The exemption bans venues from lending or extending credit, so it doesn't cover protocols like Aave.
Aave v4 just opened an Equities Hub on Base, where tokenized stocks back USDC loans, but only for non-US users.
lines.say: Aave v four just opened an Equities Hub on Base, where tokenized stocks back U.S.D.C. loans, but only for non-U.S. users.

lines.t: Open chains. Real shareholder rights. Permissioned access.
lines.say: Open chains. [[slnc 200]] Real shareholder rights. [[slnc 200]] Permissioned access.

lines.t: That's the deal the SEC just offered, for the next five years.
lines.say: That's the deal the S.E.C. just offered, for the next five years.
